text: In that month our record converges on one repair. Twenty-six of us said "sustainable growth rate," the phrase Chuck Grassley first entered on 2013-04-23; by 2014-03-14 it was our common ground. Twenty-five of us said "provider payment modernization act." Twenty-four said "repeal and medicare provider payment modernization," and twenty-four again "the sgr repeal and." The variants stack: twenty-three of us said "sgr repeal and medicare provider payment," twenty-three "the sgr repeal and medicare provider." The same 2014-03-14 peak recurs across nearly every line, the fragments of one bill name distributed among us on one day. Twenty-two of us said "members of congress," a phrase Diana DeGette entered first. We record that in this era we spoke, in large part, one legislative title, repeated in overlapping pieces, and that the repetition was ours.
